name: @gears-frontx/template-design-guardrails
description: Apply this to any FrontX project that builds screens: it supplies the design rules screens are generated from and the design review they are checked against. It adds no runtime screen and owns no application code; it installs a short human-readable entry point, the @gears-frontx/design-verify workspace package (the runtime design-defect checker and its headless render runner, the static source check, the composed-markup axe suite, and the jsx-a11y lint fragment, with their dependencies), plus an AI-extension bundle with two skills: frontx-design, which themes, builds, reviews and verifies screens by the design rules (a short map over its references, machine-readable rules and handoff templates); and frontx-design-proposal, which, when the person asks to see a page first ("show me first", "give me options", "before you build"), draws it on one local proposal page in the app's own look, records the answer in .frontx/proposals/ and builds the chosen design. The render check requires the app to stamp the applied theme's registry id as data-theme-id on <html>; the skill's references/verify.md ("Theme id stamp") gives the code for a project whose shell does not.
